page.layout: One page, a digitiser's cover sheet with a title block centred on a dark ground: the title in large capitals, a rule, then the author line in smaller type below. The Google digitiser mark at the lower right is not transcribed.
page.notes: The page is a cover-style title page, not a printed title leaf of the book. Decorative triangle patterns in the background are not printed text and are omitted. The rule between the title and the author line is an ornament.
